rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=7e-05, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, wu_sigmoid_slope=10.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-7 (one knob vs iter-1 best). NUMBERS: iter-1 0.3009(BEST lr=1.1e-4); iter-6 0.2914(lr=2e-4 UP -> worse). So the lr optimum is AT or BELOW 1.1e-4. FAILURE MODE: hr plateaus ~0.30; raising lr overshoots the shallow low-lr optimum. ONE KNOB: lr 1.1e-4 -> 7e-5 (DOWN ~0.64x, NO param change, 12 params). HYPOTHESIS: if I lower lr to 7e-5 I expect val hr >= 0.3009 because a smaller step lets the 12 scalars (per-band log_band_scale, per-iter soft_thresh/blend) settle more precisely into the asymmetric weighting without overshoot, at a fixed 12-epoch budget. If hr rises, sweep lr further down; if it drops, 1.1e-4 is the confirmed lr optimum and I move to lambda_neg / soft_thresh. Budget: same ~819s as iter-1.
